articles.titleCn: 基于Epiplexity的数据选择与生成方法，用于分布外泛化
articles.abstractCn: 现代系统被越来越期望能够在训练期间未指定的任务上进行迁移。哪些数据能够促进这些新、未预料到环境中的泛化？一个假设是，包含更多结构信息的数据可能包含可循环用于更广泛下游环境的共享电路和子程序。最近提出的衡量计算受限学习器从数据中提取的结构信息的度量——Epiplexity，为推理这种关系提供了机制。在本文中，我们展示了如何将Epiplexity作为数据选择和合成数据生成的在线训练信号进行操作化。对于选择，我们将缩放定律拟合到自然数据域的训练损失曲线上，以预测作为训练token函数的预期Epiplexity增益，并使用该信号在训练过程中自适应地确定域的采样权重。对于合成数据生成，我们将生成器的奖励定义为学习器Epiplexity在先前生成数据缓冲区中的变化，并使用REINFORCE策略梯度引导生成器朝向Epiplexity最大化的分布。在这两种情况下，更高的Epiplexity预示着在零样本和微调任务上的下游性能提升，支持了富含结构信息的数据能够产生跨领域迁移的表示的假设。

articles.title: Ripple-Pivot Search: Active Parallel Decoding for Diffusion Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have emerged as a competitive alternative to autoregressive language models, offering the potential for substantially faster inference through parallel decoding. Existing parallel decoding schedulers typically commit positions only after they meet a per-position criterion, overlooking how early commitments may benefit subsequent decoding. We identify a ripple effect in dLLM decoding: proactively committing a mid-entropy pivot position can induce a pronounced reduction in uncertainty across the remaining masked positions. This uncertainty reduction allows subsequent steps to unmask more tokens in parallel, thereby accelerating the overall decoding process. To exploit the ripple effect, we propose Ripple-Pivot Search (RPS), a novel training-free decoding method that seeks mid-entropy positions as promising candidate pivots (where to decode), and determines their token assignment that yields the greatest downstream benefit via lookahead evaluation (what to decode). Across 3 dLLMs and 4 reasoning and code-generation benchmarks, RPS achieves 4-10$\times$ wall-clock speedup over the standard decoder while preserving generation quality, and improves accuracy over the previous lookahead baseline by up to 5.49% while delivering higher throughput in most settings. When integrated with KV caching, RPS further achieves up to 18$\times$ wall-clock speedup over the standard decoder.
articles.titleCn: Ripple-Pivot Search：用于扩散大型语言模型的主动并行解码
articles.abstractCn: 扩散大型语言模型（dLLMs）已成为自回归语言模型的竞争性替代方案，通过并行解码提供了显著加快推理的潜力。现有的并行解码调度器通常只在满足每个位置的准则后才做出位置承诺，忽略了早期承诺可能如何有利于后续解码。我们在dLLM解码中识别出一种涟漪效应：主动承诺一个中等熵的关键位置可以导致剩余掩码位置的不确定性显著降低。这种不确定性降低使得后续步骤能够并行地解蔽更多标记，从而加速整体解码过程。为了利用涟漪效应，我们提出了涟漪枢轴搜索（RPS），这是一种无需训练的解码方法，它寻找中等熵的位置作为有希望的候选枢轴（解码位置），并通过前瞻评估（解码内容）确定其标记分配能产生最大下游效益。在3个dLLMs和4个推理和代码生成基准测试中，RPS在保持生成质量的同时，比标准解码器实现了4-10倍的时钟速度提升，并将准确性提高了5.49%，同时在大多数情况下实现了更高的吞吐量。当与KV缓存集成时，RPS比标准解码器实现了高达18倍的时钟速度提升。

articles.title: Locating and Controlling Implicit Personalization in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often shift their outputs in response to implicit demographic cues even when users never state a demographic identity. Previous work has documented this behavior, but the connection between these behavioral changes and the model's internal activations remains unclear. Using matched cued and neutral conversations across five LLMs, we establish that a localized internal activation signal tracks changes in recommendations, with correlations up to r=0.87. When multiple cues appear together, their internal signals largely combine, but the changes in output do not simply add up. We further show that removing the internal signal associated with one cue can suppress its influence, often more effectively than asking the model to ignore demographics via prompting, while largely preserving general benchmark performance. However, the ability to selectively remove one dimension's influence while leaving co-present dimensions intact remains highly model- and attribute-specific. These results connect implicit personalization behavior to an internal signal that can be analyzed and causally controlled.
articles.titleCn: 定位和控制大型语言模型中的隐式个性化
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）即使在用户从未声明其人口统计身份的情况下，也会根据隐含的人口统计线索调整其输出。先前的研究已经记录了这种行为，但这些行为变化与模型内部激活之间的联系尚不明确。通过跨五个LLMs的匹配提示和中性对话，我们证实了局部内部激活信号与推荐变化相关，相关系数高达r=0.87。当多个提示同时出现时，它们的内部信号会显著结合，但输出变化并不会简单地叠加。我们进一步表明，移除与某个提示相关的内部信号可以抑制其影响，其效果通常比通过提示让模型忽略人口统计信息更为有效，同时基本保留了整体基准性能。然而，选择性地移除某一维度的影响而保留其他共现维度完整的能力，仍然高度依赖于模型和属性。这些结果将隐式个性化行为与一个可分析和因果控制的内生信号联系起来。

articles.title: When the API Speaks the Wrong Language: Revisiting Post-Training for Multilingual Tool Use
articles.abstract: The reliability of Large Language Models (LLMs) for API calling degrades in multilingual settings. A common failure occurs when a model selects the correct tool but generates argument values in an inconsistent language, which we term Argument Language Mismatch (ALM). Although semantically correct, such outputs are operationally invalid and not captured by standard API-calling metrics. We revisit post-training strategies for mitigating ALM and find that, in our benchmark, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) provides a strong baseline, substantially improving argument language consistency and end-to-end function call accuracy. Under consistent model selection, SFT achieves performance comparable to, and sometimes exceeding more complex reinforcement learning (RL) approaches. We further examine whether RL with structured, argument-aware rewards offers additional benefits. While methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) can improve language consistency and better preserve general reasoning ability, these gains are incremental and most pronounced in generalization and multi-objective trade-offs. Overall, our results suggest that much of the performance in multilingual API grounding can be achieved through careful supervised training, with RL providing targeted rather than fundamental improvements.
articles.titleCn: 当API说出错误的语言：重新审视多语言工具使用的训练后微调
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）在多语言环境下的API调用可靠性会下降。一种常见的失败情况是模型选择了正确的工具，但生成的参数值语言不一致，我们称之为参数语言不匹配（ALM）。尽管语义上正确，此类输出在操作上无效，且未被标准API调用指标捕获。我们重新审视了缓解ALM的术后训练策略，发现在我们的基准测试中，监督微调（SFT）提供了一个强大的基线，显著提高了参数语言一致性和端到端函数调用准确率。在模型选择一致的情况下，SFT的性能与更复杂的强化学习（RL）方法相当，有时甚至超过。我们进一步考察了结构化、参数感知奖励的强化学习是否提供额外好处。虽然诸如组相对策略优化（GRPO）等方法可以提高语言一致性并更好地保留一般推理能力，但这些收益是渐进的，在泛化和多目标权衡中最为显著。总体而言，我们的结果表明，在多语言API基础上的大部分性能可以通过仔细的监督训练实现，而强化学习提供的是针对性而非根本性的改进。

articles.title: The Wording Effect: Quantifying Two-Way Drift in LLM Benchmark Performance
articles.abstract: A benchmark score comes from a single phrasing of each problem. That single phrasing is treated as if it stood for the whole space of ways the same problem could be asked, but it does not. We show that rephrasing a problem while keeping its meaning and answer fixed routinely flips a model's answer in both directions, so some failures become successes and some successes become failures. We call this drift. BenchDrift generates meaning-preserving variations of benchmark problems along four axes, namely linguistic, referential, pragmatic, and structural, and measures how often, and why, correctness flips under each. Across eight models and three benchmarks (GSM8K, MMLU, MATH-Hard), we observe that drift is large in both directions. Two findings stand out. First, phrasing sensitivity does not fade as models get better. Instead, it changes sign. Weak models gain more from rephrasing than they lose, while strong models lose far more than they gain. We find that the best models on a benchmark are therefore the ones whose scores depend most on the wording they happened to be given. Second, the models largely agree on which rephrasings cost the most correct answers even though they differ in how much they drift, so fragility belongs to the rephrasing and not to the model. Furthermore, rephrasing breaks answers a model was confident about, whether the problem is made shorter or longer. Code and Data: https://github.com/IBM/BenchDrift/tree/demo-ui
articles.titleCn: 措辞效应：量化大型语言模型基准测试中的双向漂移
articles.abstractCn: 基准分数来源于每个问题的单一表述。这种单一表述被视为代表了同一问题可能被提出的方式的整个空间，但它并非如此。我们证明，在保持问题和答案含义不变的情况下重新表述问题，会常规性地使模型的答案发生双向翻转，因此某些失败会变成成功，而某些成功会变成失败。我们将这种现象称为漂移。BenchDrift沿着四个轴（即语言、指称、语用和结构）生成保持含义的基准问题变体，并衡量在每个轴上正确性翻转的频率和原因。在八个模型和三个基准（GSM8K、MMLU、MATH-Hard）上，我们观察到漂移在两个方向上都很大。有两个发现尤为突出。首先，随着模型性能的提升，表述敏感性并不会减弱，而是改变符号。弱模型从重新表述中获得的收益大于其损失，而强模型损失的远大于其收益。因此，基准上表现最好的模型是那些其分数最依赖于所获得表述的模型。其次，尽管模型在漂移程度上存在差异，但它们在很大程度上同意哪些重新表述会导致最多正确答案的损失，因此脆弱性属于重新表述而非模型。此外，无论问题变短还是变长，重新表述都会破坏模型对其有信心的答案。代码和数据：https://github.com/IBM/BenchDrift/tree/demo-ui

articles.title: LEMUR: Latent Entropy-aware Multimodal Unlearning via Visual-anchored Reasoning Redirection
articles.abstract: Reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training equips multimodal large reasoning models (MLRMs) with exploratory chains of thought (CoT), substantially improving visual reasoning. However, we find that this capability introduces a distinct privacy vulnerability: even when a sensitive fact is successfully unlearned from the final answer, the model may still reproduce it in its reasoning trace. This leakage is substantially more pronounced in natively RL-trained MLRMs than in their non -reasoning base models, revealing a privacy risk that existing unlearning methods are not designed to address. We show that RL-induced exploration leaves sensitive content with a distinctive token-level entropy signature that is largely absent from base models. Based on this observation, we propose LEMUR, a fully training-free, inference-time unlearning framework for natively RL-trained multimodal models. LEMUR uses entropy dynamics as a control signal to identify when sensitive reasoning begins and when sanitization should stop. During this interval, it redirects the reasoning trajectory through entropy-modulated visual-anchor latent injection, replacing committed tokens with sanitized, probability-weighted embeddings re-grounded in the input image. Across diverse MLRMs, LEMUR consistently outperforms existing unlearning met hods in suppressing both reasoning-trace and answer leakage, while better preserving non-sensitive utility and output fluency. These results demonstrate that RL-induced entropy dynamics provide a distinctive signal for privacy leakage and that exploiting this signal enables effective training-free unlearning for reasoning-capable multimodal models.
articles.titleCn: LEMUR：基于视觉锚点推理重定向的潜在熵感知多模态去学习
articles.abstractCn: 强化学习（RL）后训练为多模态大型推理模型（MLRMs）赋予了探索性思维链（CoT），显著提升了视觉推理能力。然而，我们发现这一能力引入了一种独特的隐私漏洞：即使敏感信息已成功从最终答案中卸载，模型仍可能在推理过程中重新生成它。这种泄露在原生RL训练的MLRMs中比在它们的非推理基础模型中更为明显，揭示了现有卸载方法未能设计的隐私风险。我们表明，RL诱导的探索为敏感内容留下独特的token级熵特征，而基础模型中基本不存在这种特征。基于这一观察，我们提出了LEMUR，一种完全无需训练、推理时卸载框架，用于原生RL训练的多模态模型。LEMUR利用熵动态作为控制信号，以识别敏感推理何时开始以及何时应停止清理。在此期间，它通过熵调节的视觉锚点潜空间注入重定向推理轨迹，用基于输入图像重新校准的概率加权嵌入替换已提交的token。在多种MLRMs中，LEMUR在抑制推理轨迹和答案泄露方面始终优于现有卸载方法，同时更好地保留非敏感效用和输出流畅性。这些结果表明，RL诱导的熵动态为隐私泄露提供了独特信号，利用这一信号能够实现推理能力多模态模型的无需训练的有效卸载。

articles.title: FrontierFinance: A Challenging Benchmark for Measuring Frontier Intelligence of Finance Agents
articles.abstract: AI agents are increasingly deployed for professional investment research, yet no benchmark captures the complexity of the full investor workflow. Existing benchmarks mainly target financial data extraction, a narrow slice that current models have largely saturated, while reference-based metrics and generic LLM-as-a-judge scoring fall short on the open-ended, long-form answers that real analyst queries demand. We introduce FrontierFinance, a fully open benchmark of 220 expert-crafted queries and 11,543 source-attributed rubrics spanning six crucial use cases across the full investor workflow. FrontierFinance is both broader and harder than existing public finance benchmarks. Evaluating frontier models and agent systems under a common harness restricted to publicly available data, we find that the tool harness, not the model alone, strongly shapes quality and efficiency; that Samaya's in-house system leads at 56.0%, ahead of the strongest frontier model (Claude Fable 5, 49.2%) at roughly 2.2x lower cost; and that the best open-weight model (Kimi K3, 46.4%) nearly matches the best proprietary model at 4.5x lower cost. Screening & Discovery and Sector, Industry & Macro remain the hardest use cases across all systems, where even the best systems reach only 33% and 39%. We make the dataset and grading code publicly available.
articles.titleCn: 前沿金融：衡量金融代理前沿智能的挑战性基准
articles.abstractCn: AI代理越来越多地应用于专业投资研究，然而没有基准能够捕捉到完整投资者工作流程的复杂性。现有基准主要针对金融数据提取，而这一狭窄领域当前模型已基本饱和，同时基于参考的指标和通用LLM作为裁判的评分方式在满足真实分析师查询所需的开放式、长文本答案方面存在不足。我们介绍了FrontierFinance，这是一个完全开放的基准，包含220个专家设计的查询和11,543个来源归因的评分标准，覆盖了完整投资者工作流程中六个关键应用场景。FrontierFinance比现有的公共金融基准更广泛、更具挑战性。在仅限于公开数据的共同评估框架下评估前沿模型和代理系统，我们发现工具框架而非模型本身强烈影响着质量和效率；Samaya的内部系统以56.0%的领先优势领先，超过最强的前沿模型（Claude Fable 5，49.2%），成本约低2.2倍；最佳开放式加权模型（Kimi K3，46.4%）在成本仅高4.5倍的情况下几乎与最佳专有模型持平。筛选与发现以及行业、产业与宏观分析仍然是所有系统中最具挑战性的应用场景，即使是最优系统也仅达到33%和39%。我们公开了数据集和评分代码。

articles.title: Rubric Dropout: A Simple Way to Mitigate Reward Hacking in Rubric-as-Reward RL
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning against rubrics, lists of criteria graded by an LLM judge, has become a standard way to post-train language models on tasks with no deterministic answer. The rubric, however, is a fixed proxy for quality, never a complete description of it, and a policy trained against it long enough will learn to exploit the difference. We measure this directly. Training Qwen3-8B with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on medical and science rubrics and grading out-of-distribution (OOD) benchmarks with both the training judge and a stronger gold judge, we find that the two scores diverge during training. The training judge's score keeps climbing while the gold judge's score peaks and then falls, by 3 points on HealthBench-Hard and by 22 points on ResearchQA. A judge with a fixed bias would shift the gold curve by a constant, not send it down while the training score rises, so the divergence is reward hacking, not judge noise. We propose Rubric Dropout, a one-line fix borrowed from neuron dropout. At every step, we randomly drop a subset of the rubric's criteria before computing the reward, so the policy never optimizes the same rubric twice. The dropped subset is shared across each rollout group, so GRPO's group-relative advantages stay comparable, and evaluation always uses the full rubric. Comparing no dropout against dropout at 30% and 50% on both benchmark pairs, dropout raises the OOD gold score at every matched checkpoint (+1 to +2 points on HealthBench-Hard, +6 to +7 points on ResearchQA), lowers the two hacking measures we track, and costs nothing in domain. Sweeping the dropout fraction shows a broad 30-50% sweet spot, while the natural alternative, reweighting criteria by how useful they are to training, performs worse than no intervention at all in our setting.

articles.titleCn: 评分标准流失：一种减轻评分标准作为奖励的强化学习中的奖励攻击的简单方法
articles.abstractCn: 针对由大型语言模型（LLM）裁判评定的标准清单进行强化学习，已成为对无确定性答案的任务进行语言模型后训练的标准方法。然而，标准清单只是质量的固定代理，而非其完整描述，经过足够长时间训练针对该清单的策略将学会利用其差异。我们直接测量了这一点。使用群体相对策略优化（GRPO）在医学和科学标准清单上训练Qwen3-8B，并用训练裁判和更强的黄金裁判对分布外（OOD）基准进行评分，我们发现两个评分在训练过程中出现分化。训练裁判的评分持续上升，而黄金裁判的评分达到峰值后下降，在HealthBench-Hard上下降3分，在ResearchQA上下降22分。具有固定偏见的裁判会使黄金曲线发生恒定偏移，而不是在训练评分上升时使其下降，因此这种分化是奖励操纵，而非裁判噪声。我们提出了标准清单丢弃（Rubric Dropout），这是一种借鉴神经元丢弃的一行修复方法。在每一步，我们在计算奖励之前随机丢弃标准清单的一部分标准，因此策略不会两次优化同一个标准清单。丢弃的部分在每次展开组中共享，因此GRPO的群体相对优势保持可比性，评估始终使用完整的标准清单。比较无丢弃与在30%和50%丢弃率下的基准对，丢弃提高了OOD黄金评分（在HealthBench-Hard上提高1至2分，在ResearchQA上提高6至7分），降低了我们追踪的两个操纵指标，且在领域内不产生任何成本。扫描丢弃比例显示30-50%存在一个广泛的甜点区域，而自然替代方案，即根据标准对训练的有用性进行重新加权，在我们的设置中表现不如完全不干预。

articles.title: Hybrid-Policy Self-Editing for Composable Unstructured Knowledge Editing
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve remarkable performance across natural language tasks, yet they are trained on static corpora and their knowledge quickly becomes outdated in a fast-changing world. This motivates knowledge editing (KE), which updates specific knowledge in an LLM without changing unrelated others. Recent works move from structured knowledge triples toward unstructured KE (UKE), where the edit is a free-form passage that may state multiple facts at once. Nonetheless, existing editors inject such a passage yet fail to use it: the edited model can recall the passage, but can neither answer atomic questions about its facts nor compose them into multi-hop reasoning. We attribute this missing property, which we term composability, to editors' passive reliance on the fixed passage as the sole learning source. In response, we cast editing as a proactive self-distillation from a privileged in-context state of the same model, which requires no external supervision. We further reveal that due to the novelty of the injected knowledge, the pre-edited model's own rollouts rarely cover it, which limits the effectiveness of pure on-policy distillation. To close this gap, we propose HPSE, which builds a hybrid rollout that steps in to place missing facts onto the student's own trajectory precisely where its coverage fails, while staying on-policy elsewhere. We theoretically analyze HPSE's advantage over pure on-policy distillation, and empirically establish its plug-and-play improvements across four LLM backbones and two KE editors under various scenarios.
articles.titleCn: 组合式非结构化知识编辑的混合策略自编辑
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在自然语言任务中取得了卓越的性能，但它们是在静态语料库上训练的，其知识在快速变化的世界中很快就会过时。这促使了知识编辑（KE）的出现，它能够在不改变无关知识的情况下更新LLM中的特定知识。近期的研究从结构化知识三元组转向非结构化知识编辑（UKE），其中编辑是一个自由形式的段落，可能同时陈述多个事实。然而，现有的编辑器虽然注入了这样的段落，却未能有效利用它：编辑后的模型能够回忆起段落，但既不能回答关于其事实的原子问题，也不能将它们组合成多跳推理。我们将这种缺失的特性，称为可组合性，归因于编辑器对固定段落的被动依赖，将其作为唯一的 学习来源。为此，我们将编辑视为从模型自身的特权上下文状态中进行的主动自蒸馏，这无需外部监督。我们进一步揭示，由于注入知识的 新颖性，预编辑模型的自身推理很少覆盖它，这限制了纯在线策略蒸馏的有效性。为弥补这一差距，我们提出了HPSE，它构建了一个混合推理，在学生模型的覆盖失败之处精确地介入，放置缺失的事实，同时在其他地方保持在线策略。我们理论上分析了HPSE相对于纯在线策略蒸馏的优势，并在各种场景下，通过四个LLM主干和两个KE编辑器，实证验证了其即插即用的改进效果。

articles.title: Semantic Lenia: Emergence of Homeostatic Solitons within the Semantic Space of Large Language Models
articles.abstract: We introduce Semantic Lenia, an artificial life framework that transforms Large Language Model (LLM) inference from a static optimization problem into a continuous, closed-loop dynamical system. By establishing a non-linear homeostatic feedback loop to dynamically balance semantic attraction and syntactic repulsion, we demonstrate the emergence of ``Homeostatic Solitons''-metastable semantic structures that actively resist repetitive crystallization. Our exhaustive parameter sweeps map a critical ``Habitable Ridge'' where applied steering forces balance the model's intrinsic syntactic inertia. This approach successfully maintains generative trajectories in a numerically sensitive critical regime, triggering profound abductive leaps without structural collapse, and reveals a capacity-dependent scaling trend in the syntactic inertia across different model sizes.
articles.comment: 18 pages, 6 figures. Code, datasets, and interactive phase diagrams are available at https://y-kayama.github.io/semantic-lenia/
articles.titleCn: 语义伦尼亚：大型语言模型语义空间中稳态孤子的涌现
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了Semantic Lenia，一个将大型语言模型（LLM）推理从静态优化问题转化为连续闭环动力系统的仿生学框架。通过建立非线性稳态反馈回路，动态平衡语义吸引和句法排斥，我们展示了“稳态孤子”——一种能够主动抵抗重复结晶的亚稳态语义结构的涌现。详尽的参数扫描绘制出一条关键的“宜居脊”，其中施加的引导力与模型的内在句法惯性达到平衡。该方法成功地在数值敏感的临界区域内维持了生成轨迹，触发深刻的溯因式飞跃而无需结构崩溃，并揭示了不同模型规模下句法惯性随能力变化的缩放趋势。

articles.title: Confucius4-TTS: Transcript-Free Cross-Lingual Zero-Shot TTS with a Learnable Speaker Encoder
articles.abstract: Recent advances in zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) have substantially improved speech quality and voice cloning fidelity. However, many zero-shot TTS systems still depend on audio prompt transcripts at inference time. This dependency limits cross-lingual voice cloning, since in-the-wild reference audio is often untranscribed. In this technical report, we present Confucius4-TTS, a multilingual zero-shot TTS system that supports 14 languages and performs both intra-lingual and cross-lingual reference cloning without requiring transcripts of audio prompts. Confucius4-TTS follows a two-stage architecture, consisting of text-to-semantic (T2S) and semantic-to-acoustic (S2A) modules. The LLM-based T2S module uses a learnable speaker encoder to extract timbre features from self-supervised speech representations, and the conditional flow-matching S2A module converts the predicted semantic tokens into mel-spectrograms. The same model also supports continuation cloning when a reference transcript is available. Confucius4-TTS is trained on large-scale multilingual speech data. It achieves high intelligibility and speaker similarity on public benchmarks. On the CV3-Eval cross-lingual benchmark, Confucius4-TTS obtains an average WER of 3.73% across six directions. On our internal cross-lingual set, it achieves the best average overall rank in human evaluation among recent open-source and commercial systems. We release code, model checkpoints, and demos at https://github.com/netease-youdao/Confucius4-TTS.
articles.titleCn: Confucius4-TTS：无需文本的跨语言零样本TTS，具有可学习的说话人编码器
articles.abstractCn: 零样本文本到语音（TTS）技术的最新进展显著提升了语音质量和声音克隆保真度。然而，许多零样本TTS系统在推理时仍依赖音频提示文本。这种依赖性限制了跨语言声音克隆，因为自然场景中的参考音频通常未经转录。在本技术报告中，我们提出了Confucius4-TTS，一个支持14种语言的多语言零样本TTS系统，该系统无需音频提示文本即可执行同语言和跨语言参考克隆。Confucius4-TTS采用两阶段架构，包括文本到语义（T2S）和语义到声学（S2A）模块。基于LLM的T2S模块使用可学习的说话人编码器从自监督语音表示中提取音色特征，条件流匹配S2A模块将预测的语义标记转换为梅尔频谱图。该模型在参考转录可用时也支持延续克隆。Confucius4-TTS在大规模多语言语音数据上进行训练，在公共基准测试中实现了高可懂度和说话人相似度。在CV3-Eval跨语言基准测试中，Confucius4-TTS在六个方向上平均错误率（WER）为3.73%。在我们的内部跨语言数据集上，该系统在人类评估中优于近期开源和商业系统，获得最佳平均综合排名。我们在https://github.com/netease-youdao/Confucius4-TTS上发布了代码、模型检查点和演示。

articles.title: Who Would You Vote For? Auditing Political Alignment in LLMs: An Italian Case-Study
articles.abstract: As users increasingly turn to Large Language Models (LLMs) for information and advice on political matters, particularly during election periods, the political preferences expressed by these systems have become a matter of public interest. Prior research has shown that interactions with LLMs can influence users' political attitudes and choices, raising questions about how these models themselves evaluate political actors. In this paper, we investigate whether and how LLMs express preferences toward political parties and political leaders. We introduce a systematic and reproducible auditing framework in which multiple LLMs are prompted to evaluate parties and leaders across nine criteria. Rather than attempting to infer the models' "true" political beliefs, we focus on their observable behavior, examining consistency across evaluations, differences between models, refusal rates, and sensitivity to prompt formulation. We further investigate how these evaluations vary when models are instructed to adopt different personas. We demonstrate the framework through an Italian case study, providing a systematic analysis of LLM-generated political evaluations on italian parties and leaders.
articles.titleCn: 你会投给谁？对大型语言模型的政见审计：一个意大利案例研究
articles.abstractCn: 随着用户越来越多地利用大型语言模型（LLMs）获取政治信息和建议，特别是在选举期间，这些系统表达的政治倾向已成为公众关注的焦点。已有研究表明，与LLMs的互动会影响用户的政治态度和选择，引发人们思考这些模型自身如何评估政治人物。本文旨在探究LLMs是否以及如何表达对政党及政治领导人的偏好。我们引入了一个系统且可复现的审计框架，在该框架中，多个LLMs被提示从九个标准对政党及领导人进行评估。我们并非试图推断模型的“真实”政治信仰，而是关注其可观察的行为，考察评估中的连贯性、模型间的差异、拒绝率以及对提示措辞的敏感性。此外，我们还研究了当模型被指示采取不同角色时，这些评估如何变化。我们通过一个意大利案例研究展示了该框架，对LLMs生成的关于意大利政党和领导人的政治评估进行了系统性分析。

articles.title: Easper: An Accessible ASR Pipeline for Language Documentation
articles.abstract: Audio transcription is a critical bottleneck in language documentation. While multilingual Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) models like Whisper offer solutions, field linguists often lack the expertise to utilise them. We present Easper, an open-source, no-code workflow enabling linguists to iteratively fine-tune ASR models via cloud resources directly from ELAN annotations. Deploying ASR also raises a cold start problem: deciding which recordings to transcribe first to bootstrap an accurate model. Using Easper, we evaluate transcription prioritisation strategies on three Vanuatu languages (Bislama, Nafsan, Nguna). We fine-tune models by recording session, comparing Character Error Rate trajectories when prioritising acoustic cleanliness versus linguistic richness. We demonstrate that prioritising lexically rich narratives and increasing acoustic-phonetic repetition, even in noisy environments, leads to faster improvements in transcription quality.
articles.titleCn: Easper：一种适用于语言记录的易用语音识别流程
articles.abstractCn: 语音转录是语言记录中的一个关键瓶颈。虽然像Whisper这样的多语言自动语音识别（ASR）模型提供了解决方案，但田野语言学家通常缺乏使用它们的专长。我们介绍了Easper，这是一个开源的无代码工作流程，使语言学家能够通过云资源直接从ELAN标注中迭代微调ASR模型。部署ASR还会引发一个冷启动问题：决定首先转录哪些录音来启动一个准确的模型。使用Easper，我们在三种瓦努阿图语言（比斯lama语、Nafsan语、Nguna语）上评估了转录优先级策略。我们按录音会话微调模型，比较在优先考虑声学清洁度与语言丰富度时字符错误率的变化轨迹。我们证明，优先考虑词汇丰富的叙事，并在嘈杂环境中增加声学-音系重复，即使在小范围内也能更快地提高转录质量。

articles.title: Learning to Persuade Exposes How Easily LLMs Abandon Correct Beliefs
articles.abstract: Persuasion is a core dynamic of natural language communication, shaping how large language models (LLMs) update beliefs, resolve disagreements, and reach decisions. As LLMs increasingly debate, advise, and think collaboratively with humans and each other, resistance to harmful persuasion becomes a core requirement for reliable behavior. Yet we show that this requirement is far from met: a single targeted persuasive argument is enough to collapse model accuracy to near zero, even when the argument is factually false. We formalize this threat as adversarial persuasion and introduce an adversarial reinforcement learning framework that trains persuader agents to change a target model's answer in a single interaction. First, we show that optimizing persuasion strategies through trial and error exposes vulnerabilities that static prompting misses: RL-trained persuaders raise persuasion success from approximately 24% to over 93% against the training-time persuadee. Second, we find that these learned strategies transfer to unseen models, achieving 83% attack success on Qwen-14B, 79% on Llama-3.1-8B, and 25% on GPT-4o-mini. Third, we demonstrate that a curriculum that bootstraps on more persuadable open-weight models before targeting harder models further increases GPT-4o-mini attack success from 25% to 38%. Moreover, our results reveal that optimized persuaders increasingly rely on credibility-based tactics, including fabricated citations and false authoritative evidence. Together, these findings expose a critical weakness in current LLM agents: even when they initially reason correctly, they can be steered toward false conclusions by optimized natural language influence. This positions persuasion robustness as a necessary safety criterion for multi-agent and human-AI decision-making systems.
articles.titleCn: 学会说服揭示了大型语言模型如何轻易放弃正确信念
articles.abstractCn: 说服是自然语言交流的核心动态，影响着大型语言模型（LLM）如何更新信念、解决分歧和做出决策。随着LLM越来越多地与人类和其他模型进行辩论、提供建议和协同思考，抵抗有害说服成为可靠行为的核心要求。然而，我们证明这一要求远未得到满足：一个针对性的说服性论点就足以将模型准确率降至接近零，即使该论点在事实上是错误的。我们将这一威胁形式化为对抗性说服，并引入了一个对抗性强化学习框架，该框架训练说服者代理在单次交互中改变目标模型的答案。首先，我们证明通过试错优化说服策略会暴露出静态提示所忽略的漏洞：RL训练的说服者代理将说服成功率从约24%提高到超过93%，针对训练时的说服对象。其次，我们发现这些学习到的策略可以迁移到未见过的模型，在Qwen-14B上实现83%的攻击成功率，在Llama-3.1-8B上实现79%，在GPT-4o-mini上实现25%。第三，我们证明，在针对更难的模型之前，先在更易被说服的开权重量模型上进行引导的课程，进一步将GPT-4o-mini的攻击成功率从25%提高到38%。此外，我们的结果表明，优化后的说服者代理越来越依赖基于可信度的策略，包括编造的引用和虚假的权威证据。综合这些发现，揭示了当前LLM代理的一个关键弱点：即使它们最初能正确推理，也可能被优化的自然语言影响引向错误结论。这使说服鲁棒性成为多智能体和人类-人工智能决策系统的必要安全标准。

articles.title: VideoGAIA: A Benchmark for General AI Assistants on Agentic Video Understanding
articles.abstract: Video understanding is a fundamental task for evaluating the capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing leading models have already achieved approximately 90% accuracy on the Video-MME leaderboard, suggesting that conventional single-turn video understanding tasks are becoming increasingly saturated and insufficient for assessing the intelligence of advanced MLLMs. Towards this end, we introduce VideoGAIA, an agentic video understanding benchmark for general artificial intelligence (AI) assistants. Moving beyond one-shot video question answering, VideoGAIA formulates video understanding as a multi-turn, tool-augmented interaction process, where models must iteratively perceive videos, invoke external tools, gather complementary information, and integrate multimodal evidence across turns. VideoGAIA contains 271 model-human co-designed tasks covering diverse and complex real-world scenarios. Each video-question-answer instance is independently verified by three human experts to ensure both correctness and appropriate difficulty. All evaluated MLLMs, including frontier models such as GPT-5.5 and Kimi-K3, achieve less than 60% accuracy on VideoGAIA, highlighting its value as a high-quality and timely benchmark for evaluating next-generation MLLMs. We hope that VideoGAIA will facilitate the transition from conventional video understanding toward agentic video understanding.
articles.titleCn: VideoGAIA：面向代理视频理解通用AI助手的基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 视频理解是评估多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）能力的一项基本任务。然而，现有领先模型已在Video-MME排行榜上达到了约90%的准确率，这表明传统的单轮视频理解任务正变得越来越饱和，不足以评估高级MLLMs的智能水平。为此，我们引入了VideoGAIA，这是一个面向通用人工智能（AI）助手的代理式视频理解基准。VideoGAIA超越了单轮视频问答，将视频理解形式化为一个多轮、工具增强的交互过程，其中模型必须迭代感知视频、调用外部工具、收集补充信息，并在各轮次间整合多模态证据。VideoGAIA包含271个模型-人类共同设计的任务，涵盖了多样化和复杂的现实世界场景。每个视频-问题-答案实例都由三位人类专家独立验证，以确保其正确性和适当的难度。所有被评估的MLLMs，包括GPT-5.5和Kimi-K3等前沿模型，在VideoGAIA上的准确率均低于60%，凸显了其作为评估下一代MLLMs的高质量、及时基准的价值。我们希望VideoGAIA能够促进从传统视频理解向代理式视频理解的转变。

articles.title: Robust Multi-Tier Infant-Centered Audio Understanding with Whisper via Structured Speaker Conditioning
articles.abstract: Recent advances in model design and self-supervised audio representations have improved speech and audio understanding, yet infant-centered naturalistic recordings remain challenging due to limited labeled data, low signal-to-noise ratio, and cross-family domain shifts. We present a family-conditioned, multi-tier audio tagger that combines a LoRA-finetuned Whisper encoder with a lightweight, target-speaker-aware Transformer for long-context inference and framewise prediction across tiers. To improve temporal coherence, we incorporate a simple sequence-level smoothing loss, and to enhance robustness across households, we introduce a factorized speaker-token design with a shared tier token and a learned family-specific offset, reducing family bias and promoting generalizable representations. Together, these choices enable efficient and effective infant-centered audio tagging of daylong audio recordings in home environments.
articles.titleCn: 基于结构化说话人条件处理的Whisper的鲁棒多层以婴儿为中心的音频理解
articles.abstractCn: 模型设计和自监督音频表征的最新进展提升了语音和音频理解能力，但婴儿为中心的自然录音仍然面临挑战，原因在于标记数据有限、信噪比低以及跨家庭领域差异。我们提出了一种家庭条件化的多层级音频标注器，该标注器结合了LoRA微调的Whisper编码器和一个轻量级、目标说话人感知的Transformer，用于长上下文推理和跨层级的帧级预测。为了提高时间连贯性，我们引入了一个简单的序列级平滑损失，为了增强跨家庭的鲁棒性，我们提出了一个分解的说话人-标记设计，包含共享层级标记和学习到的特定家庭偏移量，以减少家庭偏差并促进泛化表征。这些选择共同实现了对家庭环境中全天音频录音的高效和有效的婴儿为中心音频标注。

articles.title: Reinforcing Step-level Reasoning for Effective Self-Correction in LLMs
articles.abstract: Achieving effective self-correction, where models verify and correct their own mistakes, remains a fundamental challenge for large language models (LLMs). In this work, we propose Self-Fix Step-DPO (SFS-DPO), a reinforcement learning based, two-stage framework for step-level self-verification and self-correction. The first stage strengthens step-level reasoning via step-level preference optimization, while the second stage explicitly trains models to self-verify and self-correct. We further introduce a teacher-assisted variant, SFS-DPO-R, which incorporates explanatory rationales for error verification to provide stronger corrective signals. Comprehensive in-domain and out-of-domain evaluations across multiple LLMs demonstrate that SFS-DPO and SFS-DPO-R consistently outperform prior step-level training baselines. Our analysis further reveals improvements in self-correction frequency and effectiveness, highlighting the importance of strengthening step-level reasoning for robust performance.
articles.titleCn: 强化层级推理以实现大型语言模型的有效自我纠正
articles.abstractCn: 实现有效的自我纠正，即模型验证并纠正自身错误，仍然是大型语言模型（LLMs）面临的一项基本挑战。在这项工作中，我们提出了基于强化学习的两阶段框架Self-Fix Step-DPO（SFS-DPO），用于步骤级别的自我验证和自我纠正。第一阶段通过步骤级别偏好优化加强步骤级别推理，第二阶段则明确训练模型进行自我验证和自我纠正。我们进一步引入了一种教师辅助变体SFS-DPO-R，该变体结合了错误验证的解释性推理，以提供更强的纠正信号。跨多个LLMs的领域内和领域外综合评估表明，SFS-DPO和SFS-DPO-R始终优于先前的步骤级别训练基线。我们的分析进一步揭示了自我纠正频率和有效性的提升，突出了加强步骤级别推理对鲁棒性能的重要性。

articles.title: Beyond Single-Turn Confidence: Trajectory-Adapted Uncertainty Quantification for LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods for language models are typically evaluated on single-turn outputs, where uncertainty is attached to one generated answer. For LLM agents, however, the unit of observation is an interactive trajectory, where the model can ask clarifying questions, call tools, update state, and make intermediate decisions whose errors propagate to the final outcome. We study whether three common families of single-turn UQ methods transfer to this setting. Across five LLMs and four multi-turn tool-use datasets from BFCL-v4 and $τ^2$-bench, we evaluate white-box scorers based on action-token probabilities, black-box consistency scorers based on resampled trajectories, and reflexive scorers based on model self-assessment of the trajectory. We find that transfer is often useful but uneven. Token-probability scores are highly sensitive to the choice of aggregator used across turns, reflexive scores provide the strongest low-cost baseline in most evaluated settings, and black-box self-consistency is often the strongest UQ family, with trajectory-equivalence and action-set consistency typically ranking highest among its variants. These results suggest that UQ methods developed for single generations should be revalidated at the trajectory level, with careful attention to the consistency measurement, aggregator choice, and computational budget.
articles.titleCn: 超越单轮置信度：针对LLM代理的轨迹自适应不确定性量化
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型的不确定性量化（UQ）方法通常在单轮输出上进行评估，其中不确定性附加到一个生成的答案上。然而，对于大型语言模型（LLM）代理，观察单位是交互式轨迹，模型可以提出澄清问题、调用工具、更新状态并做出中间决策，这些决策的误差会传播到最终结果。我们研究了三种常见的单轮UQ方法是否适用于这种设置。在五个LLM和来自BFCL-v4和$τ^2$-bench的四个多轮工具使用数据集上，我们评估了基于动作-标记概率的白盒评分器、基于重采样轨迹的黑盒一致性评分器和基于模型自我评估轨迹的反射性评分器。我们发现迁移通常是有效的，但效果不均。标记概率评分对跨轮次使用的聚合器选择非常敏感，反射性评分在大多数评估设置中提供了最强的低成本基线，黑盒自我一致性通常是最强的UQ方法，其中轨迹等价和动作集一致性在其变体中通常排名最高。这些结果表明，为单代开发的不确定性量化方法应在轨迹级别进行重新验证，并需仔细关注一致性测量、聚合器选择和计算预算。

articles.title: CT-$Δ$Bench: A Benchmark for Longitudinal 3D Medical Imaging Difference Reporting with Vision-Language Models
articles.abstract: In medical imaging, the clinical value of Computed Tomography (CT) lies not only in depicting current disease status, but crucially in enabling longitudinal comparison of serial scans to determine disease evolution, a process that underpins response assessment, recurrence detection, and ongoing patient management. Yet, despite this central role of temporal comparison in clinical decision-making, existing medical foundation models remain largely confined to single-study understanding, leaving temporally grounded cross-examination insufficiently addressed. To address this gap, we study longitudinal imaging difference reporting, a task in which a model takes two temporally separated scans from the same patient and generates a clinically meaningful report describing interval changes between them. We introduce CT-$Δ$Bench, a dedicated benchmark for this task with patient-level splitting to prevent information leakage. To better evaluate this task beyond surface-level text similarity, we further develop change-aware metrics specifically designed to capture clinically meaningful longitudinal changes, and conduct an independent physician validation to assess the reliability of the synthesized references and event extraction pipeline. We also compare direct paired-CT reasoning with an indirect two-stage pipeline that first generates single-timepoint reports and then performs textual differencing. Finally, we propose DeltaMed, a baseline model for direct paired-CT difference reporting, and train it on the benchmark training set. Together, these contributions lay the groundwork for temporally aware medical foundation models that better reflect real-world longitudinal clinical reasoning.
articles.titleCn: CT-$Δ$Bench：用于纵向3D医学影像差异报告的视觉-语言模型基准
articles.abstractCn: 在医学影像领域，计算机断层扫描（CT）的临床价值不仅在于描绘当前疾病状态，更关键在于通过连续扫描的比较来评估疾病进展，这一过程是响应评估、复发检测和持续患者管理的基础。然而，尽管时间比较在临床决策中具有核心作用，现有的医学基础模型仍主要局限于单次研究理解，导致基于时间跨度的交叉检验未能得到充分解决。为填补这一空白，我们研究了纵向影像差异报告任务，即模型接收来自同一患者的两个时间间隔扫描，并生成描述其间变化的临床意义报告。我们引入了CT-$Δ$Bench，这是一个专门针对该任务的基准，通过患者级别的分割来防止信息泄露。为了更深入地评估该任务，超越表面文本相似度，我们进一步开发了变化感知指标，专门用于捕捉具有临床意义的纵向变化，并进行了独立的医生验证，以评估合成参考和事件提取流程的可靠性。我们还比较了直接配对CT推理与间接两阶段流程，后者首先生成单时间点报告，然后进行文本差异分析。最后，我们提出了DeltaMed，一个用于直接配对CT差异报告的基线模型，并在基准训练集上进行了训练。这些贡献共同为构建更符合现实世界纵向临床推理的时间感知医学基础模型奠定了基础。

articles.title: On Weak Bisimilarities in CCSK
articles.abstract: In the context of CCSK, a reversible extension of CCS, we study different notions of bisimilarity (strong/weak, forward-only/reversible) and highlight their differences and commonalities. In particular, for the weak reversible case, not previously studied in the literature, we propose two variants, dubbed directional and mixed bisimilarity, depending on whether $τ$ actions should be in the same direction (forward/backward) as the action being matched or not. We show, in particular, that mixed bisimilarity is a congruence and completely abstracts away from $τ$ actions.
articles.titleCn: 在CCSK中的弱双相似性
articles.abstractCn: 在CCSK（CC的可逆扩展）的背景下，我们研究了不同类型的互模拟概念（强/弱、单向/可逆），并强调了它们之间的差异和共性。特别是针对之前文献中未研究的弱可逆情况，我们提出了两种变体，称为方向性互模拟和混合互模拟，这取决于$τ$动作是否应该与被匹配的动作保持相同的方向（正向/反向）。我们特别证明了混合互模拟是一种同构，并且完全抽象出了$τ$动作。

articles.title: Group Alignment-Induced Sycophancy: A Two-Sided Evaluation of Steerable Pluralistic Alignment
articles.abstract: Group alignment adapts a language model to a demographic group to produce responses that reflect the group's opinions, values, and preferences. Sycophancy, a well-documented by-product of alignment, causes the model to over-agree with the user regardless of factual and objective information. However, existing group alignment methods and evaluations focus only on how closely the model matches the group's opinions, overlooking the induced change in sycophantic behaviour. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{G}roup \textbf{A}lignment-induced \textbf{S}ycophancy (GAS) and systematically evaluate alignment across 3 methods, 4 models and 13 demographic groups, on both the intended gain in opinion alignment and the unintended shift in sycophancy. We find that gain and shift are non-uniform across groups: under an identical budget, some groups receive larger gains in opinion alignment than others, and the induced sycophancy shift forms a group-specific profile rather than a single-dimensional change. These results suggest that group alignment should be reported as a two-sided, multi-dimensional profile rather than a single fit score that accounts for per-group differences when adapting LLMs to diverse populations.

articles.titleCn: 群体对齐诱导的谄媚：可操控多元对齐的双向评估
articles.abstractCn: 群体对齐旨在将语言模型适配到特定群体，以生成反映该群体观点、价值观和偏好的回应。谄媚，作为对齐的一个常见副作用，会导致模型无论事实和客观信息如何，都过度同意用户的观点。然而，现有的群体对齐方法和评估仅关注模型与群体观点的匹配程度，忽略了由此产生的谄媚行为变化。为弥补这一差距，我们引入了\textbf{G}roup \textbf{A}lignment-induced \textbf{S}ycophancy (GAS)方法，并在3种对齐方法、4个模型和13个人群组上，系统性地评估了对齐在预期观点对齐收益和意外谄媚行为变化方面的表现。我们发现收益和变化在不同群体间存在不均匀性：在相同预算下，某些群体获得更大的观点对齐收益，而诱发的谄媚行为变化形成群体特有的特征，而非单一维度的变化。这些结果表明，在将大型语言模型适配到不同人群时，群体对齐应报告为双向、多维度的特征描述，而非一个考虑群体差异的单一适配分数。
